append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1659). Premise re-tested on main at 60567b67e (ADR-1082): lib/teaser.ts still held TEASER_GATE_ENABLED = false, and components/teaser-gate.tsx had one mount, components/widgets/circles/circle-feed.tsx, where teaserAllowed() returned true for everyone and the wrapper rendered its children untouched. The flag is a code constant, not a database row, so no migration. DELETED: lib/teaser.ts, components/teaser-gate.tsx, components/teaser-gate.test.tsx. The Circle feed now returns its <section> directly, the markup the switched-off wrapper already produced. Three comments that pointed at the deleted file (components/upsell/upsell-tease.tsx, lib/pricing/upsell-tease.ts, components/pricing/meter-upsell.tsx) were reworded; docs/TEASER-GATE.md section 2 and the docs/VALUE-LADDER.md dead-code table now say the gate is retired. TEST: components/widgets/circles/circle-feed.test.tsx renders the feed for a signed-in non-member (the viewer the gate was built to tease) and a member, and asserts a plain section with no preview timer, upgrade prompt, blur or dialog. The repo has no check-orphans script; the orphan sweep was the probe's tree walk plus check:phantom and check:docs-links.
